verdict.rationale: Deel documents in-platform document submission and digital intake forms. Businesses and workers can "complete forms, submit required documents" with real-time status, and the US visa journey is "fully digital" from intake forms to tracking. Document requirements also come with the eligibility assessment. Missing for 10: explicit document checklists, reminders for outstanding document requests (only visa expiry/renewal reminders are documented), details of how the upload workflow works, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments

citations.quote: businesses and their workers can easily complete forms, submit required documents, pay fees, receive real-time visa application status updates
the entire US visa journey is now fully digital. It's all managed within our platform, from eligibility checks to intake forms and application tracking
Quickly assess visa options with results delivered within 48 hours, including a cost breakdown and document requirements.
